subject: general
question: The 'Lohit' is a tributary of which river from following?
solution:
​The correct answer is "__**Brahmaputra**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The river **Lohit** runs through both **China** and **India**.
 
• The **Zayu River** is another name for the Lohit River.
 
• The **Brahmaputra River** receives water from the Lohit River. 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**Brahmaputra**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The Brahmaputra river system is one of the largest rivers in the world. In the Tibet region, it is known by the name of Yarlung Tsangpo. It enters by the names of Siang and Dihang in India.
 
• It flows in Bangladesh by the name of Jamuna. Finally, it merges with the Ganga river.
 
• The primary tributaries of the Brahmaputra river include - the Dhansiri river, Lohit river, Dibang river, Subansiri river, Kameng river, Sankosh river, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://lotusarise.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/brahmaputra-river-system.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bhupen Hazarika Setu**, also known as the **Dhola-Sadiya Bridge**, is a beam bridge that crosses the Lohit River in India.
 
• The Brahmaputra River crosses international borders as it travels through **Bangladesh, India, and Tibet**.
 
• The Brahmaputra River is the **15th-longest** and ninth-largest river in the world by discharge.
